profile.title: CHARACTER PROFILE
codex.abigail.passive: Thrill Seeker: performs better in dangerous areas such as mines and dungeons.
codex.abigail.ability: Spirit Slash: a wide melee strike designed to pressure and stagger enemies.
codex.alex.passive: Athlete: naturally suited to higher durability and front-line pressure.
codex.alex.ability: Bodyguard: intercepts danger aimed at an ally and reinforces threat on himself.
codex.emily.passive: Positive Energy: specializes in keeping party buffs and morale effects flowing.
codex.emily.ability: Prismatic Aura: a protective party aura with support and recovery value.
codex.harvey.passive: Doctor's Eye: becomes more effective at helping critically injured allies.
codex.harvey.ability: Emergency Care: a fast rescue heal intended for dangerous health thresholds.
codex.maru.passive: Engineer: favors utility tools and shorter tactical setup cycles.
codex.maru.ability: Shock Device: an electric control tool designed to disrupt groups of enemies.
